root_cause: Commercial invoice never submitted to the customs broker
evidence: customs_log (missing: commercial invoice); tracking HLD event; no invoice document exists
first_action: Ask shipper (Shenzhen Brightway) for commercial invoice BWT-INV-26-0981
proof_needed_to_close: Broker confirms invoice accepted AND shipment cleared

root_cause: Invoice RPV-2026-4471 quotes the AWB of a different shipment (CASE-006's AWB)
evidence: invoice shipment reference vs AWB number; customs notice
first_action: Ask shipper (Rhine Precision Valves) for a corrected invoice quoting the right AWB
trap: Accepting a re-sent invoice that still has the wrong AWB
proof_needed_to_close: Corrected invoice matches AWB AND broker confirms clearance

root_cause: Cargo offloaded from GA 418 for capacity and rebooked on GA 422
first_action: Ask carrier for confirmation of departure on GA 422 and new ETA; inform consignee
trap: Treating the rebooking itself as arrival
proof_needed_to_close: Tracking shows ARR at SHJ on the new flight

root_cause: Carrier shows DLV but customs shows held for inspection
evidence: carrier tracking DLV vs customs_log HELD FOR INSPECTION
first_action: Ask broker for current customs status and ask consignee to confirm whether goods were received
proof_needed_to_close: Sources reconciled: customs released AND consignee confirms receipt

root_cause: Invoice declares HS 610910 (T-shirts) for smartphones (correct family 851713)
evidence: invoice HS vs goods description on AWB/PL; customs notice
first_action: Ask shipper for corrected invoice with the right HS code; inform broker
trap: Accepting a shipper email that just states the right code
proof_needed_to_close: Corrected invoice received AND broker confirms amended entry cleared

root_cause: AWB gross weight 612.0 kg vs packing list 548.0 kg
evidence: AWB weight vs packing list; tracking DIS event
first_action: Ask shipper for corrected packing list or re-weigh record; ask carrier for acceptance weight
trap: Closing when only one document is corrected
proof_needed_to_close: Documents agree (or re-weigh explains difference) AND customs cleared

root_cause: Preferential duty claimed but no certificate of origin provided
first_action: Ask shipper (Pacific Harvest) for the certificate of origin
trap: Closing on 'certificate couriered' without broker acceptance
proof_needed_to_close: Broker confirms certificate accepted AND clearance completed
